nato.py.summary: Spell text with the NATO phonetic alphabet.
details: Takes the text as an argument or from ``-f`` and prints the letters as the NATO words (Alpha, Bravo ... Zulu), ignoring everything that is not a letter.

ncdu.py.summary: An ``ncdu``-style disk usage browser in Python.
details: Scans the directory in parallel (eight workers, hardlink dedup, optional one-file-system and apparent size), shows the tree in a curses browser sorted by size, name, item count or mtime, and can export or import the ncdu JSON format (``-o``/``-f``) without the UI.

nch.py.summary: Normalise the file and directory permissions of a tree.
details: Sets the directories to 0775 and the files to 0644 (configurable), adds the execute bit to the scripts (shebang, ``.sh``/``.so`` suffix or the ``bin``-style parent folders) and removes it elsewhere, with ``--no-preserve-existing-exec``, ``--dir-mode``/``--file-mode`` and the parallel/serial runners.
nch.py.notes: Changes the permissions of every file below the path; review the list before running it on a system tree.

nerf_mp3.py.summary: Re-encode MP3 files at half their original bitrate.
details: Reads the bitrate with ffprobe, re-encodes each file with ffmpeg at 50 % (floor 8 kbps) in a process pool, reports the size change per file and the totals and skips the files that cannot be read.

nettools.py.summary: Network toolkit: proxies, IP, ping, DNS and signal.
details: Subcommands: ``proxy-test`` checks the proxies of a file concurrently, ``net-info`` prints the public and local IP with a speed test, ``ping`` parses the ``ping`` output into statistics, ``set-dns`` switches the resolver to a public provider, ``show-ip`` prints the addresses and ``signal`` monitors the Android Wi-Fi/cellular signal.

noneng.py.summary: Detect the non-English text files of a directory.
details: Detects the language of each text file with pycld2 (or the ``-b`` backend) on a 4 KB sample, skipping the files with too few letters, prints the detected language and optionally saves the report; the files are scanned in a pool.

noneng_all.py.summary: Detect the language of every file below a directory.
details: Runs pycld2, gcld3, cld3, langdetect, py3langid, fast-langdetect or lingua (``-b``) on each file and prints the language and the confidence, with ``--only-non-english`` for the filtered list.

noneng_langdet.py.summary: Detect the non-English content of text files recursively.
details: Checks the lines with the ``langdetect`` backend (confidence 0.85 by default), filters by length and extension, writes the findings to ``noneng.txt`` or ``-o`` and processes the tree with a pool and a per-file progress report.

nonutf8.py.summary: Report the files whose encoding is not UTF-8.
details: Detects the encoding from the BOM or by decoding attempts, prints the non-UTF-8 files and with ``-a`` converts them to UTF-8 in place.

normalize_print_sep.py.summary: Normalise the ``sep`` argument of the ``print`` calls in Python files.
details: Rewrites the ``print(..., sep=...)`` calls to the canonical spacing, reports the affected files and with ``-a`` applies the change in place (the default is a dry run).

notebook_convert_tool.py.summary: Convert between Jupyter notebooks, scripts and Markdown.
details: Subcommands: ``to-py`` exports a notebook as a script (``--hoist-imports``, ``--wrap-main``, magic stripping), ``to-md`` exports it as Markdown, ``to-ipynb`` rebuilds a notebook from a script (split by defs/imports, blanks or one cell), ``strip`` clears the outputs and ``meta-to-ipynb`` turns a Markdown document into cells.

nr.py.summary: Create a GitHub repository from the current folder and push it.
details: Reads the token from ``~/.env``, copies ``~/.gitignore``, initialises the repository if needed, creates it through the REST API (``-p`` for private) and commits and pushes the current branch; ``-y``/``-f`` skip the confirmations.

nvim_plugin_toolbox.py.summary: Neovim plugin helper: folderize, lock and split.
details: The ``folderize`` subcommand moves the ``.lua`` files into per-plugin folders by the references they contain, ``lock`` writes a ``lazy-lock.json`` from the installed lazy.nvim plugins (with the git commit of each) and ``split`` breaks a plugin-spec table into one file per plugin; ``--dry-run`` previews.
